decisions.reason: The hyaluronic serum fits the natural facial care range and costs little to keep, but after two years with no clear sign of traction its option value is shrinking, and the firm has already shown it will prune facial lines, so the withdrawal risk is moderate.

The cleansing oil was launched only in 2024 and may replace the dropped cleansing milk, so its prospects are still uncertain and keeping it in small-batch production is cheap enough to justify holding the option open.
